resources.name: Heat capacity data for Bi and Bi2O3

access.notes: Cp vs T measurements for bismuth and bismuth trioxide from ~60 K to 300 K, equivalent to Table II of the source paper. Provided as an inline table in the task instruction.

resources.notes: Contains temperature (K) and Cp (cal/(K·mol)) columns for both compounds.

notes: The Debye temperatures (θ=147 K for Bi, θ=97 K for Bi2O3) are given as fixed parameters; the agent does not need to fit them.
